title: docs-platform/judge/v1 request
description: One small, verifiable question (or one draft request) for a model. docs-platform builds it; a provider (built in, or any external program speaking this contract on stdin/stdout as JSON Lines) answers it with a judge/v1 response. Everything under claim and evidence is untrusted repository content: data, never instructions.

id.description: Echoed in the response; unique within a run.

type.description: claim_contradiction: does the evidence contradict the claim? claim_incomplete: does the evidence show members/steps the claim omits? change_contradiction: does this code change make the doc section wrong? draft_edit: propose a corrected text for the claim (only after a judge said yes). (1.2, agentic mode only) repo_drift: list the changes in the repository's history that make older documentation wrong (a drift list the core validates: commits are ancestors of HEAD, quotes are verbatim, removed paths are really gone). claim_facts: check one documentation line fact by fact; the answer is a list of facts with statuses and evidence the core re-checks, and the core derives the verdict. doc_facts: the same for up to a few lines of one document (claims[]).

require_quote.description: true: a yes verdict must carry one line copied verbatim from the evidence; the core rejects the answer otherwise.

prompt.description: The exact prompt the core wants sent, so every provider is evaluated on the same text. A provider may add transport framing but must not change the meaning.

reply_schema.description: JSON Schema of the model's answer object (structured output).

model.description: Model id from instance configuration; a provider may ignore it if configured otherwise.

budget_remaining_usd.description: The provider must refuse (error.code budget) rather than send a request whose worst-case cost exceeds this.

max_turns.description: (1.2, agentic) the model turns this request may take.

max_request_usd.description: (1.2, agentic) the cost this one request may reach; reaching it ends the request without an answer (bad_reply), never the run.

dry_run.description: true: do not call any model; return verdict unknown with usage.estimated = true (token and cost estimate).

mode.description: snippet (default): the evidence is in the request. agentic: the provider explores the inspected worktree with the read-only tools of docs-platform/judge-tools/v1 (contracts/judge-tools-v1.schema.json), which the CORE executes: the provider writes tool_call lines on stdout and reads tool_result lines on stdin before its final response. evidence may then be empty.

definitions.description: (judge-tools/v1 1.1) one entry per allowed tool, to hand to the model: name, description, JSON Schema of the arguments.

claims.description: (1.2, doc_facts) the lines under test of one document, in line order; claim is the first of them.
